trimmingRules.2p: Remove all pact cards from the military decks before play (Age I has 2 pacts, Ages II and III have 4 each). Pacts are used only in 3- and 4-player games. (Civil decks: remove the 6 cards marked 3+ and the 3 cards marked 4 from each of the Age I/II/III civil decks.)
trimmingRules.3p: No military-deck cards are removed. (Civil decks: remove the 3 cards marked 4 from each of the Age I/II/III civil decks.)
trimmingRules.source: 1j1ju_rulebook.pdf (Full Game setup, p.22) + cge_code_of_laws.pdf (setup): military cards carry no 3+/4 corner marks; the only player-count trimming of military decks is the removal of all pacts in 2-player games.

metadata.ageAEventSeeding: Shuffle the Age A military deck (10 event cards); place the top (players+2) cards face down as the current events deck (2p:4, 3p:5, 4p:6). Return the rest to the box unseen. No one ever draws Age A military cards.
metadata.tacticsRules2015: Playing a tactic from hand costs 1 military action (Action Phase). After you replenish the card row at the start of your next turn (before your Politics Phase) the card moves to the common tactics area, where any player may copy it for 2 military actions. Age II/III tactics show a second, lesser strength used for outdated armies (any unit in the set 2+ levels lower than the tactic's age).
